name: The St. Anthony
insider_take: San Antonio's grande dame of hospitality, The St. Anthony has been setting the standard for luxury since 1909 — where Gilded Age grandeur meets modern Luxury Collection elegance in the heart of the Alamo City.
whats_special: One of Texas' oldest luxury hotels, The St. Anthony has hosted presidents, celebrities, and royalty — Dwight D. Eisenhower and Bob Hope among its legendary guests. The rooftop pool and terrace offer stunning views over historic Alamo Plaza, a rare vantage point few visitors ever experience. A meticulous multi-million dollar restoration preserved its stunning Spanish Colonial Revival architecture while weaving in contemporary Luxury Collection amenities.
pro_tip: Ask for a room with a view facing Travis Park — especially magical during the holiday season when the park's lights reflect off the hotel's grand windows.
dont_miss: Cocktails at the iconic St. Anthony Club Bar, a storied social hub since Prohibition days. The famous San Antonio River Walk is just steps away — perfect for an evening stroll or a boat tour along the historic waterway. The Alamo, Texas' most visited landmark, is a short walk from the hotel's front door.
pros: Historic luxury hotel with century-old charm and character
Prime downtown location near River Walk and major attractions
Elegant ballrooms and event spaces for special occasions
Premium Marriott STARS Program benefits and service
cons: Historic building may have older infrastructure
